summary: Clean Rust service implementation using the repository pattern with generic trait bounds. UserService has proper input validation (empty name check, email format validation), uses anyhow::Result for error propagation, and follows Rust idioms well. The generic type parameter R: UserRepository enables clean dependency injection for testing.

items.description: Consider adding a more thorough email validation (e.g., regex or a validation crate) instead of only checking for '@' presence.
